title: Before exam day
body_html:
• Try the vendor's exam sandbox or demo, if they offer one, so the question screens are familiar.
  • Read the official identification and room rules for your delivery partner, and take the required ID.
  • If you need extra time or other help, request an accommodation on the official channel early.
  • Check the product names on the official outline. Vendors sometimes rename a product and still use the old name in a question.
